newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Chase, Dao Heng to deal in Philippine debt.
newsitem.headline: Chase, Dao Heng to deal in Philippine debt.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission said on Friday it has approved the application of Dao Heng Bank and Chase Manhattan Bank to be dealers of government securities.
The U.S.-based Chase Manhattan Bank and Hong Kong's Dao Heng Bank started operations in the country recently with the liberalization of the banking industry.
Dao Heng Bank established its presence through a 60-40 joint venture with local investors.

Chase Manhattan's operations here was paved by its recent merger with Chemical Bank which was one of the ten foreign banks allowed by the government to set up their 100 percent-owned full-service branches.
